mapper.select: SELECT M.MEMBER_SEQ, M.EMAIL, M.NICKNAME, M.GENDER, M.MEMBER_STATUS AS status, M.CREATED_AT, B.BLACKLIST_SEQ AS member_blacklist_seq, B.REASON AS blacklist_reason, NULL AS admin_memo, CASE WHEN B.BLACKLIST_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'INACTIVE' END AS blacklist_status FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MEMBER_SEQ, MAX(BLACKLIST_SEQ) AS MAX_SEQ FROM BLACKLIST WHERE RELEASED_AT IS NULL AND (END_AT IS NULL OR END_AT > SYSTIMESTAMP) GROUP BY MEMBER_SEQ ) L ON M.MEMBER_SEQ = L.MEMBER_SEQ LEFT JOIN BLACKLIST B ON L.MAX_SEQ = B.BLACKLIST_SEQ ORDER BY M.MEMBER_SEQ DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BLACKLIST ( BLACKLIST_SEQ, MEMBER_SEQ, ADMIN_SEQ, REASON, START_AT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_BLACKLIST.NEXTVAL, #{memberSeq}, #{adminSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{blacklistReason}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE BLACKLIST SET RELEASED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, RELEASED_BY = #{adminSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq} AND RELEASED_AT IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT BANNED_WORD_SEQ, WORD, CATEGORY, REPLACEMENT, USE_YN, CREATED_AT FROM BANNED_WORD ORDER BY BANNED_WORD_SEQ DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BANNED_WORD ( BANNED_WORD_SEQ, WORD, CATEGORY, REPLACEMENT, USE_YN, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_BANNED_WORD.NEXTVAL, #{word}, #{category}, NVL(#{replacement}, '***'), 'Y', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT PHOTO_REVIEW_SEQ, MEMBER_SEQ, PHOTO_URL, AI_SCORE, IS_AI_SUSPECT, STATUS FROM PHOTO_REVIEW WHERE PHOTO_REVIEW_SEQ = #{photoReviewSeq}
mapper.update: UPDATE PHOTO_REVIEW SET STATUS = #{status}, REJECT_REASON = #{rejectReason}, REVIEWED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE PHOTO_REVIEW_SEQ = #{photoReviewSeq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PHOTO_REVIEW ( PHOTO_REVIEW_SEQ, MEMBER_SEQ, PHOTO_URL, AI_SCORE, IS_AI_SUSPECT, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_PHOTO_REVIEW.NEXTVAL, #{memberSeq}, #{photoUrl}, NVL(#{aiScore, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0), NVL(#{isAiSuspect, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N'), NVL(#{status, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'WAITING'), SYSDATE )
